bundle.shortDescription: A desktop tool for managing Vintage Story game servers
bundle.longDescription: Shulius Vintage Server Manager is a desktop application for managing Vintage Story dedicated game servers. It provides server lifecycle control, mod management, save file backups, and network diagnostics.
